test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Unadulterated and unabashed were/ the two words that the judge use/ to define his performance

options.text: the two words that the judge use

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"the two words that the judge use".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"use"** of the sentence.
 
• As the first part of the sentence is in the past tense, to maintain uniformity in the sentence, we must use **"used."**
 
• The correct verb form should be **"used"** instead of **"use"**, as it should agree with the singular subject **"judge".**
 
• So, the correct answer is** option 2.**

 

**Correct sentence: ***Unadulterated and unabashed were **the two words that the judge used**__ to define his performance.*
